description: On the table in front of you there’s a round white tabletop-like piece with a threaded hole in the center, and a separate white cross-shaped support piece nearby. The left hand stays resting on the surface while the right hand reaches to the cross-shaped piece, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up, and brings it over the round piece to align it above the center opening as if inserting the support into the tabletop.
